allowance_formula: max(policy_period, ceil(T_matched_HOLD / T_physical_HOLD) * (control_activation_tick + control_receipt_confirmation_tick)) = max(.020, 2*(.005+.005)) = .020 s
eligibility_formula: for every phase p: T_min[p]-1e-9 <= actual T[p] <= T_min[p]+.020+1e-9 AND unchanged independent complete-task physical evaluator PASS
fairness: identical physical task, commissioned Human, initial condition and common earliest phase clocks; identical upper timing allowance for all methods; no waypoint/segment imitation; actual waiting cost always included
native: original free-duration complete task; unchanged .5s contiguous valid physical HOLD minimum; never pooled with matched ranking
scope_limit: Matched clocks leave within-phase pacing and up to 60ms total residual duration variation. Do not infer pure coordination from native differences, or perfect timing isolation from eligibility alone.
